## 变更说明 / Change

- 关联 Issue / Linked issue:
- 变更内容与原因 / What changed and why:

## 项目变更 / Project change

仅在新增、更新或下架项目时填写。新增项目必须关联带有 `status: approved` 的项目提交 Issue；通常由维护者在 Issue 审核通过后整理条目。

Complete this section only when adding, updating, or removing a project. A new listing must link to a project-submission issue labeled `status: approved`; the maintainer normally prepares the listing after issue approval.

- [ ] 在线体验和主体源码可公开访问（C1 / C2 / D5）。 / The live product and substantive source are publicly accessible (C1 / C2 / D5).
- [ ] AI 实质参与核心功能实现，工具、参与深度、协作方式及公开证据完整（C3 / C5 / D4）。 / AI substantially implemented core features, with complete tools, depth, workflow, and public evidence (C3 / C5 / D4).
- [ ] 条目准确说明问题、功能与价值、主要技术栈及质量依据（C4 / D1 / D2 / D3）。 / The listing accurately states the problem, features and value, main stack, and quality evidence (C4 / D1 / D2 / D3).
- [ ] 已更新 `data/projects.json` 并运行 `python scripts/render_catalog.py`；未直接编辑 README 的生成区域。 / I updated `data/projects.json`, ran `python scripts/render_catalog.py`, and did not edit generated README regions directly.

## 检查 / Checks

- [ ] 变更内容集中，链接可访问，且不含密钥、密码或个人敏感信息。 / The change is focused, its links work, and it contains no secrets, passwords, or personal data.
